userStories.title: App academic e model Teacher
userStories.description: As a secretaria, I want to register a teacher with CAPES category, accreditation dates, academic degree, and links to research lines and projects, so I can maintain the program's faculty roster.
acceptanceCriteria: App academic criado seguindo a estrutura padrão do projeto (models.py, admin.py, router.py, schemas.py, migrations/, tests/), registrado em INSTALLED_APPS

Model Teacher: person (OneToOneField to people.Person, on_delete=PROTECT, related_name='teacher_profile'), category (TextChoices PERMANENT/COLLABORATOR/VISITING = 'Permanente'/'Colaborador'/'Visitante'), accredited_since (DateField), accredited_until (DateField, null=True, blank=True), academic_degree (TextChoices DOCTORATE/POSTDOCTORATE/HABILITATION = 'Doutor'/'Pós-doutor'/'Livre-docente'), lattes_url (URLField, blank=True), home_institution (CharField, blank=True), research_lines (ManyToManyField to programs.ResearchLine, related_name='teachers', blank=True), projects (ManyToManyField to programs.CollectiveProject, related_name='teachers', blank=True)
Registrado no Django Admin do app academic
Migração criada e revisada (arquivo lido, não só gerado)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Model Student
userStories.description: As a secretaria, I want to register a student with level, mandatory project, optional advisor, status, and regimental deadline, so I can track their academic life in the program.
acceptanceCriteria: Model Student no app academic: person (OneToOneField to people.Person, on_delete=PROTECT, related_name='student_profile'), level (TextChoices MASTERS/DOCTORATE = 'Mestrado'/'Doutorado'), project (FK to programs.CollectiveProject, on_delete=PROTECT, related_name='students', obrigatória/not null), advisor (FK to Teacher, on_delete=PROTECT, related_name='advisees', null=True, blank=True), registration_number (CharField, max_length=30, null=True, blank=True, unique=True), status (TextChoices REGULAR/LEAVE/ISOLATED/ELECTIVE/EXCLUDED = 'Regular'/'Trancado'/'Isolada'/'Eletiva'/'Excluído', default REGULAR), admission_date (DateField), deadline (DateField), defense_date (DateField, null=True, blank=True)

Regra de deadline: se não informado na criação, calcular automaticamente como admission_date + 24 meses (level MASTERS) ou + 48 meses (level DOCTORATE), implementada como método no próprio model chamado em save() quando deadline for None; depois de criado, o campo é livremente editável
Sem validação de transição de status — troca livre entre quaisquer valores, nenhum método de invariante para esse campo
Registrado no Django Admin do app academic
Migração criada e revisada (arquivo lido, não só gerado)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass (teste em memória, sem banco: criar Student sem deadline informado e verificar que o valor calculado bate com a regra de 24/48 meses por nível)
userStories.notes: Depende de US-002 (CollectiveProject) e US-003 (Teacher) já terem sido implementadas.
